caption: The drawing depicts a wooden musical instrument with a rectangular box-shaped body and a keyboard. The instrument is elevated on two ornately carved vertical legs, each decorated with floral or foliage motifs in a lighter color. The body of the instrument is brown with visible wood grain and features similar lighter decorative inlay or painted designs on its front and sides. The keyboard, composed of alternating white and black keys, is partially exposed under a lid that is propped open at an angle. Above the keyboard, a wooden music stand is mounted on the lid, consisting of two angled slats forming a "V" shape to hold sheet music. Attached below the main body is a pedal mechanism connected by a rod to the base, where a rectangular metal pedal rests on a horizontal support bar between the legs. The overall artwork is rendered in naturalistic colors and is set against a plain, light beige background, with the artist's signature, "JOSEPH CRANWELL A.R.", visible on the lower right area.
title: Cottage Organ
